# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
devtools::load_all(".")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, dpi = 150)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = paste0("saved_images_", Sys.Date(), "/"),  # Saves all images to a folder named 'saved_images'
  dev = "png",                 # Formats: "png", "jpg", "pdf", or "svg"
  dpi = 400                    # Ensures high-quality images
)
```

```{r process-data, include=FALSE}
# Process GDX files to standard CSV format (skips if files already exist).
# Set force = TRUE to re-process after data updates.
process_fasom_gdx(force = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
year_range <- "2020-2060"
```

## Ozone Inputs

```{r load-ozone-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ozone_crop_2015_updated  <- read_dataset("crop_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_15O26P")  
ozone_for_2015_updated    <- read_dataset("for_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_15O26P")

ozone_crop_2015  <- read_dataset("crop_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2015")  
ozone_for_2015  <- read_dataset("for_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2015")

ozone_crop_2026  <- read_dataset("crop_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026")
ozone_for_2026  <- read_dataset("for_ryg_summary.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026")

ozone_crop_for_inputs <- c("2026_IASD_RYG_v4_15O26P", "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2015", "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026")
```

### Models

```{r, ozone-yield}
df <- 
  bind_rows(ozone_crop_2015_updated, ozone_crop_2015, ozone_crop_2026) %>% 
  mutate(variable = case_when(variable == "wheat" ~ "Wheat",
                              TRUE ~ variable))

plot <- telescope::plotting(
  df = df,
  figtype = "bar",
  fb_title_name = "Ozone-Related Yield Gain by Region",
  fb_figure_no = "",
  fb_x = "region",
  fb_y = "value",
  fb_color = "model",
  fb_regions = c(
    "CB",
    "GP",
    "LS",
    "NE",
    "RM",
    "PSW",
    "PNWW",
    "PNWE",
    "SC",
    "SE",
    "SW",
    "Total"
  ),
  fb_models = ozone_crop_for_inputs,
  fb_years = "2020-2100",
  fb_scenarios = "75ppb",
  fb_variable = c("Cotton", "Corn", "Wheat", "Soybeans"),
  fb_facet1 = "variable",
  fb_options = "Start y axis at 0",
  fb_x_title = "Region",
  fb_y_title = "Value",
  fb_y_units = "percent",
  fb_subtitle = "Major field crops, W126 exposure = 75ppb",
  fb_caption = paste0("Source: ", paste0(unique(df$datasrc), collapse = ", "))
) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent())

print(plot)

# TODO: Add annotation for missing Wheat total
```

```{r, ozone-growth}

                              TRUE ~ variable))
```

## CMAQ Inputs

```{r load-exposure-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ozone_vals_2015_updated  <- read_dataset("crop_ozone_vals.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_15O26P")  
ozone_vals_2015  <- read_dataset("crop_ozone_vals.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2015")  
ozone_vals_2026  <- read_dataset("crop_ozone_vals.csv",  model_filter = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026")
ozone_vals_inputs <- c("2026_IASD_RYG_v4_15O26P", "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2015", "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026")
```

## Welfare

```{r, ag_welfare}
df <- telescope::read_dataset("FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcomparesummary.csv") %>% 
  mutate(variable = case_when(variable == "grtotal" ~ "Total US",
                              variable == "Process" ~ "Processing",
                              variable == "producer" ~ "Producer",
                              variable == "US_dom_demand" ~ "Consumer", 
                              TRUE ~ variable))

plot <- telescope::plotting(
  df = dplyr::filter(df, .data[["category"]] %in% "gtotal"),
  figtype = "timeseries",
  fb_title_name = "Agricultural Welfare % Change from Baseline",
  fb_figure_no = "",
  fb_x = "year",
  fb_y = "value",
  fb_color = "scenario",
  fb_regions = NULL,
  fb_models = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026",
  fb_years = year_range,
  fb_scenarios = c("75ppb", "70ppb", "65ppb"),
  fb_variable = c("Consumer", "Producer", "Processing", "Total US"),
  fb_facet1 = "variable",
  fb_options = "Start y axis at 0",
  fb_x_title = "Year",
  fb_y_title = "% change from baseline",
  fb_subtitle = "75ppb, 70ppb, 65ppb",
  fb_caption = "Source: FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcomparesummary.csv",
  fb_hline0 = TRUE,
  fb_pct_change = TRUE
)

print(plot)
```

```{r, forestry_welfare}
df <- telescope::read_dataset(
  c(
    "FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcompareforconssurplus.csv",
    "FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcompareforprodsurplus.csv"
  )
) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(category %in% "forestry") %>% 
  mutate(entry = case_when(entry == "n_wcompareforconssurplus" ~ "Consumer Surplus",
                           entry == "n_wcompareforprodsurplus" ~ "Producer Surplus",
                           TRUE ~ entry))

df_aggregate <- df %>% 
  group_by(year, variable, region, category, subcategory, scenario, model) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(entry = "Total (Consumer + Producer)")

df <- bind_rows(df, df_aggregate)

plot <- telescope::plotting(
  df = df,
  figtype = "timeseries",
  fb_title_name = "Forest Welfare % Change from Baseline",
  fb_figure_no = "",
  fb_x = "year",
  fb_y = "value",
  fb_color = "scenario",
  fb_regions = "US",
  fb_models = "2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026",
  fb_years = year_range,
  fb_scenarios = c("75ppb", "70ppb", "65ppb"),
  fb_variable = "US_dom_demand",
  fb_facet1 = "entry",
  fb_options = "Start y axis at 0",
  fb_x_title = "Year",
  fb_y_title = "% change from baseline",
  fb_subtitle = "75ppb, 70ppb, 65ppb",
  fb_caption = "Source: FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcompareforconssurplus.csv, FASOM/2026_IASD_RYG_v4_2026/n_wcompareforprodsurplus.csv",
  fb_hline0 = TRUE,
  fb_pct_change = TRUE
)

print(plot)
```
